csv_project_name: PM for As-Needed CIP Project Management Support Services
csv_agency: County of Orange Public Works / Procurement
csv_scope_of_work: OC Public Works intends to pre-qualify firms to provide services for Architect-Engineer (A-E) and A-E related County-wide and District-wide services for their various maintenance and capital projects. OC Public Works, on behalf of the County of Orange (County) and Orange County Flood Control District (District), requires supplemental professional services to meet workload demands and project scheduling commitments in relation to Architect-Engineer (A-E) Design, Project Administration and Management Services for various projects. A-E is defined as an Architect or Engineer for design and/or engineering of a project. To supplement existing resources, County intends to issue CIP Project Management Support Services Task Orders for use by County and District on an "as-needed" basis.
